what_pip_says: Press the green A button to play!
text_on_screen: PRESS THE GREEN A BUTTON TO PLAY!

what_pip_says: Are you still there? Press A to keep playing!
text_on_screen: ARE YOU STILL THERE? PRESS A TO KEEP PLAYING!

what_pip_says: Pick your scientist! Move left or right, then press A.
text_on_screen: PICK YOUR SCIENTIST!

what_pip_says: Hi! I'm Pip the penguin!
text_on_screen: HI! I'M PIP THE PENGUIN!

what_pip_says: I want to see inside a tiny, tiny cell.
text_on_screen: I WANT TO SEE INSIDE A TINY, TINY CELL.

what_pip_says: Cells are too small to see with our eyes!
text_on_screen: CELLS ARE TOO SMALL TO SEE WITH OUR EYES!

what_pip_says: Let's make a 3 D picture of one. Follow me!
text_on_screen: LET'S MAKE A 3D PICTURE OF ONE. FOLLOW ME!

what_pip_says: Walk to the freezers. Look for the gold arrow!
text_on_screen: WALK TO THE FREEZERS. LOOK FOR THE GOLD ARROW!

what_pip_says: Next stop: the fib S E M! Follow the arrow.
text_on_screen: NEXT STOP: THE FIB-SEM! FOLLOW THE ARROW.

what_pip_says: Now the giant microscope: the Cry-oss!
text_on_screen: NOW THE GIANT MICROSCOPE: THE KRIOS!

what_pip_says: Last stop: the computer!
text_on_screen: LAST STOP: THE COMPUTER!

what_pip_says: Use the stick to walk. Press A at the gold arrow!
text_on_screen: USE THE STICK TO WALK. PRESS A AT THE GOLD ARROW!

what_pip_says: Not yet! Let's go in order. Follow the gold arrow.
text_on_screen: NOT YET! LET'S GO IN ORDER. FOLLOW THE GOLD ARROW.

what_pip_says: We did that one already. Follow the gold arrow!
text_on_screen: WE DID THAT ONE ALREADY. FOLLOW THE GOLD ARROW!

what_pip_says: This is the freezing station. Brrr!
text_on_screen: THIS IS THE FREEZING STATION. BRRR!

what_pip_says: What shall we look inside today? Pick a sample!
text_on_screen: WHAT SHALL WE LOOK INSIDE TODAY? PICK A SAMPLE!

what_pip_says: Bacteria!
text_on_screen: BACTERIA!

what_pip_says: Yeast!
text_on_screen: YEAST!

what_pip_says: A tiny worm!
text_on_screen: A TINY WORM!

what_pip_says: Bacteria are super tiny. Some live in your tummy and help you!
text_on_screen: BACTERIA ARE SUPER TINY. SOME LIVE IN YOUR TUMMY AND HELP YOU!

what_pip_says: A drop of bacteria is very thin.
text_on_screen: A DROP OF BACTERIA IS VERY THIN.

what_pip_says: Yeast is a tiny fungus. It helps make bread fluffy!
text_on_screen: YEAST IS A TINY FUNGUS. IT HELPS MAKE BREAD FLUFFY!

what_pip_says: A drop of yeast cells is thin.
text_on_screen: A DROP OF YEAST CELLS IS THIN.

what_pip_says: This little worm is smaller than a grain of rice!
text_on_screen: THIS LITTLE WORM IS SMALLER THAN A GRAIN OF RICE!

what_pip_says: But it is much thicker than a drop of cells.
text_on_screen: BUT IT IS MUCH THICKER THAN A DROP OF CELLS.

what_pip_says: Water in cells can turn into spiky ice crystals.
text_on_screen: WATER IN CELLS CAN TURN INTO SPIKY ICE CRYSTALS.

what_pip_says: So we freeze super fast. The water turns into smooth glass ice!
text_on_screen: SO WE FREEZE SUPER FAST. THE WATER TURNS INTO SMOOTH GLASS ICE!

what_pip_says: Thin things go in the plunge freezer. Thick things go in the high pressure freezer.
text_on_screen: THIN THINGS: PLUNGE FREEZER. THICK THINGS: HIGH PRESSURE FREEZER.

what_pip_says: Which machine should we use?
text_on_screen: WHICH MACHINE SHOULD WE USE?

what_pip_says: Hmm... That one is for thick things. Try the other one!
text_on_screen: HMM... THAT ONE IS FOR THICK THINGS. TRY THE OTHER ONE!

what_pip_says: Hmm... That one is for thin things. Try the other one!
text_on_screen: HMM... THAT ONE IS FOR THIN THINGS. TRY THE OTHER ONE!

what_pip_says: Yes! Great choice!
text_on_screen: YES! GREAT CHOICE!

what_pip_says: This is the Leica E M G P 2. It is a plunge freezer.
text_on_screen: THIS IS THE LEICA EM GP2. IT IS A PLUNGE FREEZER.

what_pip_says: The grid is a tiny metal net. It is smaller than your fingernail!
text_on_screen: THE GRID IS A TINY METAL NET. IT IS SMALLER THAN YOUR FINGERNAIL!

what_pip_says: Press A when the dropper is over the grid!
text_on_screen: PRESS A WHEN THE DROPPER IS OVER THE GRID!

what_pip_says: Oops, missed! Try again.
text_on_screen: OOPS, MISSED! TRY AGAIN.

what_pip_says: Plop! Nice drop!
text_on_screen: PLOP! NICE DROP!

what_pip_says: Too much water! Hold A to soak it up. Let go in the green!
text_on_screen: TOO MUCH WATER! HOLD A TO SOAK IT UP. LET GO IN THE GREEN!

what_pip_says: A little more! Hold A again.
text_on_screen: A LITTLE MORE! HOLD A AGAIN.

what_pip_says: Perfect! A super thin layer of water.
text_on_screen: PERFECT! A SUPER THIN LAYER OF WATER.

what_pip_says: A bit too dry, but okay!
text_on_screen: A BIT TOO DRY, BUT OKAY!

what_pip_says: Now quick! Press A to plunge!
text_on_screen: NOW QUICK! PRESS A TO PLUNGE!

what_pip_says: Splash! Into liquid ethane. It is about minus 180 degrees!
text_on_screen: SPLASH! INTO LIQUID ETHANE. IT IS ABOUT -180 °C!

what_pip_says: That's even colder than my home at the south pole!
text_on_screen: THAT'S EVEN COLDER THAN MY HOME AT THE SOUTH POLE!

what_pip_says: This is the Leica E M Ice. It is a high pressure freezer.
text_on_screen: THIS IS THE LEICA EM ICE. IT IS A HIGH PRESSURE FREEZER.

what_pip_says: Press A to tuck the worm into its tiny metal sandwich!
text_on_screen: PRESS A TO TUCK THE WORM INTO ITS TINY METAL SANDWICH!

what_pip_says: Tap A again and again to pump up the pressure!
text_on_screen: TAP A AGAIN AND AGAIN TO PUMP UP THE PRESSURE!

what_pip_says: Full pressure! Freeze!
text_on_screen: FULL PRESSURE! FREEZE!

what_pip_says: That's twice as much squeeze as the bottom of the deepest ocean!
text_on_screen: THAT'S TWICE AS MUCH SQUEEZE AS THE BOTTOM OF THE DEEPEST OCEAN!

what_pip_says: Squeezing stops spiky ice. Then liquid nitrogen freezes it in a flash!
text_on_screen: SQUEEZING STOPS SPIKY ICE. THEN LIQUID NITROGEN FREEZES IT IN A FLASH!

what_pip_says: Let's zoom in on the water!
text_on_screen: LET'S ZOOM IN ON THE WATER!

what_pip_says: Frozen slowly, water makes spiky crystals. Ouch!
text_on_screen: FROZEN SLOWLY, WATER MAKES SPIKY CRYSTALS. OUCH!

what_pip_says: Frozen super fast, it becomes smooth glass ice. The cell is safe!
text_on_screen: FROZEN SUPER FAST, IT BECOMES SMOOTH GLASS ICE. THE CELL IS SAFE!

what_pip_says: Scientists call this vitrification! That means turning into glass.
text_on_screen: SCIENTISTS CALL THIS VITRIFICATION!

what_pip_says: Your sample is frozen! Now we keep it super cold.
text_on_screen: YOUR SAMPLE IS FROZEN! NOW WE KEEP IT SUPER COLD.

what_pip_says: Let's take it to the fib S E M!
text_on_screen: LET'S TAKE IT TO THE FIB-SEM!

what_pip_says: This is the Zeiss Crossbeam five fifty.
text_on_screen: THIS IS THE ZEISS CROSSBEAM 550.

what_pip_says: It has two beams: one to look, and one to cut!
text_on_screen: IT HAS TWO BEAMS: ONE TO LOOK, AND ONE TO CUT!

what_pip_says: Our sample is too thick to see through. We must cut a thin slice!
text_on_screen: OUR SAMPLE IS TOO THICK TO SEE THROUGH. WE MUST CUT A THIN SLICE!

what_pip_says: Find a nice, whole cell. Move the target and press A!
text_on_screen: FIND A NICE, WHOLE CELL. MOVE THE TARGET AND PRESS A!

what_pip_says: Find a nice, whole worm. Move the target and press A!
text_on_screen: FIND A NICE, WHOLE WORM. MOVE THE TARGET AND PRESS A!

what_pip_says: That one is on the metal bar. Try another!
text_on_screen: THAT ONE IS ON THE METAL BAR. TRY ANOTHER!

what_pip_says: That one is broken. Try another!
text_on_screen: THAT ONE IS BROKEN. TRY ANOTHER!

what_pip_says: Too many cells squished together. Try another!
text_on_screen: TOO MANY CELLS SQUISHED TOGETHER. TRY ANOTHER!

what_pip_says: There's nothing there. Look for a bump!
text_on_screen: THERE'S NOTHING THERE. LOOK FOR A BUMP!

what_pip_says: What a nice cell!
text_on_screen: WHAT A NICE CELL!

what_pip_says: What a nice worm!
text_on_screen: WHAT A NICE WORM!

what_pip_says: First, a shiny metal coat to protect the top. Hold A to spray!
text_on_screen: FIRST, A SHINY METAL COAT TO PROTECT THE TOP. HOLD A TO SPRAY!

what_pip_says: Shiny! Like a suit of armor.
text_on_screen: SHINY! LIKE A SUIT OF ARMOR.

what_pip_says: Now the ion beam! Hold A and dig away the orange parts.
text_on_screen: NOW THE ION BEAM! HOLD A AND DIG AWAY THE ORANGE PARTS.

what_pip_says: Keep the gold slice in the middle!
text_on_screen: KEEP THE GOLD SLICE IN THE MIDDLE!

what_pip_says: Careful! Don't dig the gold slice!
text_on_screen: CAREFUL! DON'T DIG THE GOLD SLICE!

what_pip_says: Great digging! Now polish it even thinner.
text_on_screen: GREAT DIGGING! NOW POLISH IT EVEN THINNER.

what_pip_says: We made a lamella! That means a super thin slice.
text_on_screen: WE MADE A LAMELLA! THAT MEANS A SUPER THIN SLICE.

what_pip_says: It's hundreds of times thinner than one hair!
text_on_screen: IT'S HUNDREDS OF TIMES THINNER THAN ONE HAIR!

what_pip_says: Now to the giant microscope: the Cry-oss!
text_on_screen: NOW TO THE GIANT MICROSCOPE: THE KRIOS!

what_pip_says: This is the Titan Cry-oss G 4. It is huge!
text_on_screen: THIS IS THE TITAN KRIOS G4. IT IS HUGE!

what_pip_says: It shoots tiny electrons through our slice to take pictures.
text_on_screen: IT SHOOTS TINY ELECTRONS THROUGH OUR SLICE TO TAKE PICTURES.

what_pip_says: Inside there is no air at all, and it stays super cold!
text_on_screen: INSIDE THERE IS NO AIR AT ALL, AND IT STAYS SUPER COLD!

what_pip_says: Press A to load our grid into the robot loader!
text_on_screen: PRESS A TO LOAD OUR GRID INTO THE ROBOT LOADER!

what_pip_says: Where is our slice? Find the glowing lamella and press A!
text_on_screen: WHERE IS OUR SLICE? FIND THE GLOWING LAMELLA AND PRESS A!

what_pip_says: There it is! Zoom in!
text_on_screen: THERE IT IS! ZOOM IN!

what_pip_says: That's not it. Look for the glowing slice!
text_on_screen: THAT'S NOT IT. LOOK FOR THE GLOWING SLICE!

what_pip_says: Now we tilt the slice and take pictures from many sides.
text_on_screen: NOW WE TILT THE SLICE AND TAKE PICTURES FROM MANY SIDES.

what_pip_says: Like walking around a statue to see all of it!
text_on_screen: LIKE WALKING AROUND A STATUE TO SEE ALL OF IT!

what_pip_says: Move the gold circle onto the glowing part. Press A to snap!
text_on_screen: MOVE THE GOLD CIRCLE ONTO THE GLOWING PART. PRESS A TO SNAP!

what_pip_says: Oops! Center it first, then snap.
text_on_screen: OOPS! CENTER IT FIRST, THEN SNAP.

what_pip_says: Electrons are strong. Quick pictures keep the cell safe.
text_on_screen: ELECTRONS ARE STRONG. QUICK PICTURES KEEP THE CELL SAFE.

what_pip_says: We took 13 pictures! Scientists call this a tilt series.
text_on_screen: WE TOOK 13 PICTURES! SCIENTISTS CALL THIS A TILT SERIES.

what_pip_says: Let's build the 3 D picture on the computer!
text_on_screen: LET'S BUILD THE 3D PICTURE ON THE COMPUTER!

what_pip_says: The computer puts all the pictures together...
text_on_screen: THE COMPUTER PUTS ALL THE PICTURES TOGETHER...

what_pip_says: Ta da! A 3 D tomogram!
text_on_screen: TA-DA! A 3D TOMOGRAM!

what_pip_says: Now we can dive through the cell, slice by slice.
text_on_screen: NOW WE CAN DIVE THROUGH THE CELL, SLICE BY SLICE.

what_pip_says: Push up and down to dive. Press A when something glows!
text_on_screen: PUSH UP AND DOWN TO DIVE. PRESS A WHEN SOMETHING GLOWS!

what_pip_says: The membrane! It's the cell's skin.
text_on_screen: THE MEMBRANE! IT'S THE CELL'S SKIN.

what_pip_says: Membranes! This kind of bacteria has two skins, one inside the other!
text_on_screen: MEMBRANES! THIS KIND OF BACTERIA HAS TWO SKINS, ONE INSIDE THE OTHER!

what_pip_says: Ribosomes! Tiny factories that make proteins.
text_on_screen: RIBOSOMES! TINY FACTORIES THAT MAKE PROTEINS.

what_pip_says: A mito-condree-on! The cell's power plant.
text_on_screen: A MITOCHONDRION! THE CELL'S POWER PLANT.

what_pip_says: The new-clee-us! It keeps the cell's D N A safe.
text_on_screen: THE NUCLEUS! IT KEEPS THE CELL'S DNA SAFE.

what_pip_says: The D N A! It's the cell's instruction book. Bacteria have no new-clee-us.
text_on_screen: THE DNA! IT'S THE CELL'S INSTRUCTION BOOK. BACTERIA HAVE NO NUCLEUS.

what_pip_says: A fla-jell-um! A tail that spins like a propeller!
text_on_screen: A FLAGELLUM! A TAIL THAT SPINS LIKE A PROPELLER!

what_pip_says: Muscle fibers! They pull so the worm can wiggle!
text_on_screen: MUSCLE FIBERS! THEY PULL SO THE WORM CAN WIGGLE!

what_pip_says: You found them all!
text_on_screen: YOU FOUND THEM ALL!

what_pip_says: And this is a real tomogram from our lab!
text_on_screen: AND THIS IS A REAL TOMOGRAM FROM OUR LAB!

what_pip_says: Look! This is a real picture from our lab!
text_on_screen: LOOK! THIS IS A REAL PICTURE FROM OUR LAB!

what_pip_says: Amazing! Three stars!
text_on_screen: AMAZING! THREE STARS!

what_pip_says: Great job! Two stars!
text_on_screen: GREAT JOB! TWO STARS!

what_pip_says: Good job! You got a star!
text_on_screen: GOOD JOB! YOU GOT A STAR!

what_pip_says: You did it! You are a cryo E T scientist!
text_on_screen: YOU DID IT! YOU ARE A CRYO-ET SCIENTIST!

what_pip_says: Thanks for playing. Come back soon!
text_on_screen: THANKS FOR PLAYING. COME BACK SOON!
